name: How soon can I cook and use my kitchen after it has been painted?

mainEntity.name: How soon can I cook and use my kitchen after it has been painted?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can typically step into your kitchen for light use, such as grabbing items from the refrigerator, within a few hours after walls are dry to the touch. However, paint requires extended time to fully cure and achieve maximum durability. Most modern acrylic and latex paints cure in 14 to 30 days. During the first two to three weeks, avoid scrubbing the walls, placing hot appliances directly against painted surfaces, or wiping down fresh cabinet doors with harsh chemical cleaners. Gentle care during the curing window ensures the finish hardens properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Light kitchen use is usually fine after 24 hours. Full cure takes 14 to 30 days, so avoid scrubbing walls, heavy steam, or harsh cleaners during that curing period.
